caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, ornate tankard or mug as the central object, rendered in shades of gray on a muted beige background. The tankard has a rounded, bulbous body that narrows towards the top and bottom, a wide circular foot, and a thick, decorative handle featuring scroll-like embellishments near its base and top. The tankard’s opening is circular and its lip is wide and slightly flared outward. The main drawing is framed by a rectangular outline, and in the lower left corner of the page, there is a smaller, simplified line drawing of the same tankard, enclosed within a square. The smaller drawing is less detailed, showing only the basic silhouette and handle without shading. The composition is centered, and the tankard’s placement within the page ensures that it is the primary focus, while the smaller inset drawing provides a reference for its outline.
title: Silver Mug
